name: Game Collecting Simulator
source:
In "Game Collecting Simulator", play as the new collector in town, Thomas. Interact with other game enthusiasts and hunt for the games you want.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2320030/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在“游戏收集模拟器”中，扮演镇上的新收藏家托马斯。与其他游戏爱好者互动并寻找你想要的游戏。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2320030/]Steam[/url]]
